ticker.name: Jiangsu Xinde Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd

business_summary: Jiangsu Silicon Integrity Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures semiconductor equipment. It offers products, such as JSSI Turn-key Technical Solution, JSSI For Bumping, JSSI Product Test Capability, JSSI For WLCSP, JSSI For BGA, and JSSI Core Equipment for Traditional Package. The company was founded in 2020 and is based in Nanjing, China.
business_summary_ko: Jiangsu Silicon Integrity Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd.는 반도체 장비를 제조합니다. JSSI 턴키 기술 솔루션, Bumping용 JSSI, JSSI 제품 테스트 기능, WLCSP용 JSSI, BGA용 JSSI 및 기존 패키지용 JSSI 핵심 장비와 같은 제품을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 2020년에 설립되었으며 중국 난징에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
